faqs.a:
The council may at the time of ordering the acquisition of district sewers or at any
               time thereafter order the acquisition of subdistrict laterals in any such subdistrict
               so as to connect the same with the submains or with the district main sewer, the same
               to be approved by ordinance as in the case of district sewers.
(Code 1981, § 27-127; Ord. No. 551, § 68, 5-14-1964)
